description: This line plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity, measured as average cosine similarity, between generated training samples (with K=32) across 64 distinct relation categories, as presented in the paper “Generating Diverse Training Samples for Relation Extraction with Large Language Models.” The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” spans integer values from 0 to 64, representing individual relation categories, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.5, with major gridlines at 0.1 intervals. Three primary solid lines represent different experimental conditions: “w/o DPO obo” (blue, circle markers), “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” (orange, square markers), and “DPO” (green, diamond markers). Two dashed lines represent their respective moving averages: “Average of w/o DPO obo” (blue dashed), “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” (orange dashed), and “Average of DPO” (green dashed). The blue line exhibits high variability, peaking sharply at approximately 0.48 around category 32 and dipping to near 0.0 at category 64. The orange line also shows high volatility, with a peak near 0.43 at category 60 and a sharp drop to 0.03 at category 62. The green line remains relatively stable and low, mostly below 0.15, with a peak of about 0.22 at category 27. Horizontal reference lines are drawn at 0.158 (orange dashed), 0.107 (blue dashed), and 0.086 (green dashed), corresponding to the average similarity values for each condition. The plot visually contrasts the higher and more erratic similarity scores of the “w/o DPO” methods against the lower, more consistent scores of the “DPO” method.
